old_caption: A person in white boots uses a cleaning tool to agitate a gray shag rug laid on a white protective sheet. The tool moves across the rug, lifting and pushing a brown, muddy slurry that flows onto the sheet below. The surrounding area contains cleaning equipment, including a blue fan in the background. The cleaning tool, branded "PROTIMA," is actively engaged in the process, moving from right to left across the rug's surface, progressively clearing a path of cleaner, wetter fibers while the dirty water and debris accumulate in front of it.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases the process of cleaning a rug using a specialized cleaning machine. Initially, the camera focuses on a close-up view of the rug being cleaned, highlighting the texture and the foam solution being applied. The machine's brush attachment moves back and forth across the rug, agitating the foam to lift dirt and grime from the fibers. As the camera pans out, we see the entire rug laid flat on a protective sheet, with the cleaning machine positioned at one end. The machine's brush continues its methodical cleaning motion, ensuring thorough coverage. The surrounding area includes cleaning equipment and supplies, indicating a professional setting. The video captures the transformation of the rug from dirty to clean, emphasizing the effectiveness of the cleaning process.
caption: The video showcases an indoor rug-cleaning bay where a beige shaggy rug lies on a white tarp mottled with brown stains. A worker in tall white rubber boots stands at the far edge, guiding a long-handled extraction wand whose head bears a PROTINA label. A thick brown mass of dirty foam already sits on the rug as the wand drags it leftward and toward the camera. The mass elongates and spreads, deforming rather than sliding rigidly across the fibers. Near the front-left edge it breaks into a turbulent brown stream that pours over the foreground tarp. The wand lifts and hovers above the corner, leaving the left strip wetter and flatter while the right stays dry and shaggy. A blue blower remains fixed in the upper-right background, while a bright reflection streak lies on the foreground tarp.
